notes.title: Pack Lunch Summer Event!
notes.content:
[p][b]Summer is here so we're heading to the beach.[/b] [b][u]It's the Pack Lunch Summer Event![/u][/b][/p][p]And that can only mean one thing: SANDwiches! We've got triangles, rectangles, bagels, subs, and the all new floury baguette! [/p][p][b]But wait, there's more![/b]:[/p][list][*][p]A new [b]Bonus Stage[/b] featuring 12 new puzzles, taking the total number of levels to over 100!; [/p][/*][*][p]A new lunchbox design: the sandcastle bucket - in a variety of colours; [/p][/*][*][p]New designs including: the floury baguette, sun cream and a new shell; [/p][/*][*][p]New stage art;[/p][/*][*][p]6 new beach themed level backgrounds; and,[/p][/*][*][p]3 new shapes.[/p][/*][/list][p]These are also the biggest and most complex levels so far, featuring all of the most interesting shapes and tastiest designs. You can access this new Bonus Stage from the Bonus Stages menu once you have completed Stage 6.[/p][p]
[b]Pack Lunch is currently ON SALE until 10th July 2025![/b]
[/p][p]Other changes in Patch 1.3:[/p][list][*][p]Updated store page assets;
[/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Thank you for supporting Pack Lunch and Wear Sun Cream![/b][/u][/p]

notes.title: Pack Lunch Picnic Event!
notes.content:
[b]Summer is fast approaching and Picnic Season is here![/b]

[b]Welcome everyone.[/b] [b][u]I am pleased to announce the Pack Lunch Picnic Update![/u][/b]

In Update 1.2, I've added a new Bonus Stage to Pack Lunch which celebrates all things picnic-y. There's a new hamper and backgrounds, new shapes to play with, and a new Belgian Bun design! Add in a rosette from the dog show and plenty of waffles, and you've got the perfect picnic!

This new Bonus Stage is unlocked upon completing Stage 5 and can be found via the "Bonus Stages" button on the Pack Lunch home menu.

Other changes include:
- Visual update for all buttons;
- Bonus Stage buttons added for all future Bonus Stages. Press them to reveal expected release dates. How exciting!

notes.title: Pack Lunch Easter Event!
notes.content:
[b]Welcome Everyone, Happy Easter![/b]

[b][u]I am pleased to announce the Pack Lunch Easter Update![/u][/b]

With Patch 1.1, a new Bonus Stage has been added to Pack Lunch with new Easter themed designs. So there's eggs and hot cross buns, Easter Baskets with coloured ribbons, and bold new background designs in bright pastel shades. A few new shapes have been added too!

This new Bonus Stage is accessed through a new button on the home menu and is unlocked upon completing Stage 4. So anyone who has already completed Stage 4 will have instant access to the new Bonus Levels! 

Keen eyes will also notice that there's room for more Bonus Stages in the future, so watch this space!

Other updates include:
- Refresh button now triggers the room transition effect;
- Long overdue support for brown bread enjoyers and rectangle sandwich gang!

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Changes:
Controls updated - You can now rotate shapes by pressing spacebar or right mouse button, whichever you prefer. As a result, base controls should now be better optimised for Steam Deck users;
Tutorial updated -  To include the above update. Additional information for Steam Deck users also added.

Pro tip:
Rapidly alternate between pressing the right mouse button and the spacebar for faster rotations.
